source: zam-os/zam holds no de-by cell for Realschule Grade 7 geography whose items are not already mapped by another Academy package. The Grade 7 Europe cell de-by:realschule-7-geographie-europa-raum-wirtschaft belongs to the approved Geographie 6 Realschule mapping. The tropics, trade-wind and desert items of the legacy Grade 8 and Grade 9 cells (tests/fixtures/legacy in zam-os/zam) are taught in Grade 7 under the current LehrplanPLUS, but each already has a row in the Geographie 8 or Geographie 9 Realschule mapping. Thomas decided on 2026-11-25 in the Claude Code chat for Academy PR #200 to leave the Grade 8 items J01 and J03 in the Geographie 8 mapping ("Leave them in Geo 8"); see docs/geographie-7-coverage.md. No replacements, retirements or review-history transfers are proposed.
